en.heroIntro: I am Nanxi Li, a junior undergraduate in the JohnClass at Zhiyuan College, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, majoring in Computer Science. I am currently an undergraduate research intern at SafoLab, Johns Hopkins University, advised by Prof. Chaowei Xiao. Previously, I was mentored by Prof. Yong-Lu Li in the RHOS Lab at SJTU and interned at Tencent XuanWu Lab. My research interests include, but are not limited to, multimodal learning as well as AI safety and security. I am always open to discussions and potential collaborations — feel free to reach out!
